title: Best of Sri Lanka from Hyderabad
highlights: Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage on your Sri Lanka trip where you'll meet adorable elephants in their natural habitat.
Visit beautiful Kandy and explore its famous attractions like the Temple of Tooth Relic and Royal Botanical Gardens.
Explore the iconic Lotus Tower, and the peaceful Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple on an assisted tour of Colombo.
Enjoy the unique surroundings of the Pettah Floating Market, shop for souvenirs and try delicious food.
overview:
Lying just southward of India, the island nation of Sri Lanka is renowned for its vibrant culture and heritage. Designed to offer a quick glimpse of the fantastic country, the Colombo tour package from Hyderabad takes one across two of Sri Lanka’s biggest destinations- Kandy and Colombo.
Thriving with heritage marvels and modernist landmarks alike, the capital city of Colombo beckons every avid traveller to itself. Kandy, on the other hand, is known for its fantastic natural beauty. Brimming with plantations and forests, Kandy’s brilliant beauty is manifested in its little lakes and ancient temples. Offering the best of both, this fantastic package makes sure you get a glimpse of Sri Lanka at its best.
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Standard Hotel
Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
1 night stay in Kandy with breakfast
Half Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
2 nights stay in Colombo with breakfast
Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis - Ticket/Cost not included
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: International travellers are advised to keep their identity proof with them throughout the tour.
All travellers should carry their Thrillophilia booking voucher to the tour.
Any activities partaken of on leisure days will not be included as part of the package.
Do not litter or disturb the sanctity of any of the attractions you visit while on the tour.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
One complimentary water bottle (500ml) each person each day.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.
